scripts.dev: { test -f packages/sdk/dist/index.js || npm run build --workspace=packages/sdk; } && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/sdk && npm run build --workspace=packages/create-webapp && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/create-webapp && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.cloudflare:build: npm run build --workspace=packages/sdk && npm run cf:build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run cloudflare:build && npm run cf:deploy --workspace=apps/web
scripts.cloudflare:dry-run: npm run cloudflare:build && npm run cf:dry-run --workspace=apps/web
